_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_cast_copy_alternative_cost.py. t_cane_copy is Blue Mage's Cane's granted trigger as a sorcery: exile an instant or sorcery card from an opponent's graveyard, copy it, and offer the copy's cast for {3} rather than its mana cost. t_cane_draw_x is a copied card with an X in its cost, which the {3} price leaves at 0 (107.3). t_cane_murder is a copied card whose only legal targets are creatures.

cards.name: Test Cane Lesson
cards.oracle_text: Exile target instant or sorcery card from an opponent's graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy by paying {3} rather than paying its mana cost.
